definitions.explanation: Indicates something that happened very recently, within the past few minutes.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}しがた⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It just arrived a moment ago.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}しがた⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Mr. Tanaka just called a moment ago.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}しがた⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: They just left a moment ago.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}しがた⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦なんです→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: This is something I just heard a moment ago.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ (now) + しがた (a form of ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ marking the immediate past)

TIME FRAME: The very recent past - typically the last few minutes, not hours.

REGISTER: Slightly formal. Common in business communication, polite conversation, and news reporting; less common in very casual speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たった{今|いま}→たった今：20560_tattaima⟧ - "just now" (very common, neutral)
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧ - "a while ago" (casual, covers a longer span)
- ⟦{先|さき}ほど→先程：04165_sakihodo⟧ - "earlier" (polite, formal)
- ⟦ついさっき→ついさっき：noentry⟧ - "just a moment ago" (casual emphasis)

CONTRAST WITH さっき:
- {今|いま}しがた: seconds to a few minutes ago
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧: minutes to an hour or so ago

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今|いま}しがた + past tense: reports a just-completed action
- {今|いま}しがた〜⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: emphasizes how recent it is
